description: Restore a hosted website from a Backsies backup: everything, files only, chosen paths, or chosen databases. The live site is backed up first. Checked before confirm; preview says what is replaced. Confirm required; the confirm returns runId for oma_backsies_status. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

paths.description: Relative paths under the site home, e.g. public_html/wp-content/uploads.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_backsies_restore
title: Restore website from backup
